paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: WLD-0026 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Music festival adds second stage SOURCE_NAME: Raven Wire SOURCE_TYPE: news RELIABILITY: 2 PUB_DATE: 2025-07-11 PUB_TIME: 16:25 COUNTRY: Tolan SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Music festival adds second stage

[P1] Organisers of a music festival on Tolan have added a second stage after tickets sold faster than expected. The new stage will host smaller acts and local bands, with a gap of an hour between sets to avoid crowding.
[P2] The festival will run for three days in a meadow outside the main town. Camping is included in the ticket, and shuttle buses will run between the site and the town centre until midnight.

[P3] Organisers asked visitors to bring refillable water bottles and to leave glass containers at home. A quiet area has been set aside for families, and a team of volunteers will patrol the campsite overnight.
